description: This Java class represents pagination data for web applications, providing properties and methods to manage pagination details like page size, current page, offset, total count, and total pages.

classes.name: PaginationData
classes.description: A POJO class for managing pagination details in a web application.

methods.name: PaginationData
methods.description: Constructor initializing pageSize and currentPage with validation on pageSize.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the number of results per page.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current page number based on offset and page size.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates and returns the offset (0-based index) for data retrieval.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PaginationData instance representing the next page.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PaginationData instance representing the previous page.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of results.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of results.

methods.name: getTotalPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pages based on total count and page size.
